title: The Map That Defined a District
fact_notes: 人物・出来事・制度は架空の教材例。実在の調査・統計・実証結果や法律・選挙区の規則ではない。制作台帳は来歴確認用。

sentences.en: In a fictional town, the council plans to divide its residential area into districts for the purpose of organizing community meetings.
sentences.ja: 架空の町で議会は地域会議を組織するため住宅地を地区に分けようとする。

sentences.en: The first proposal places approximately the same number of residents in each district, using a computer-generated map.
sentences.ja: 最初の案はコンピューター生成地図を使って各地区にほぼ同数の住民を配置する。

sentences.en: The planners describe the boundaries as neutral because they were calculated according to a numerical rule rather than drawn by individual officials.
sentences.ja: 計画者は個々の職員が引いたのでなく数値規則で計算したため境界を中立と説明する。

sentences.en: A resident questions whether the equal distribution of population is sufficient to establish that the resulting districts will serve their intended purpose.
sentences.ja: 人口の均等配分で地区が目的を果たすと判断するには十分か、一住民が疑問を呈する。

sentences.en: The proposed map divides a neighborhood whose residents frequently use the same community facilities.
sentences.ja: 提案地図は住民がよく同じ地域施設を使う近隣地域を分断している。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, another district contains two residential areas separated by a railway, with only a limited number of convenient crossings.
sentences.ja: 一方別地区には鉄道で分けられ便利な横断箇所が限られる二つの住宅地が含まれる。

sentences.en: The resident argues that the map's arithmetic may be accurate while its assumptions about people's ability to meet remain open to question.
sentences.ja: 住民は地図の計算が正確でも人々が集まれるかについての前提には疑問の余地があると主張する。

sentences.en: Officials consequently distinguish numerical equality from the practical accessibility of the activities that the districts are intended to support.
sentences.ja: そこで職員は数値的平等と地区が支えることを意図した活動の実際の利用しやすさを区別する。

sentences.en: The council prepares several alternative maps and publicly explains the different criteria used to produce them.
sentences.ja: 議会は複数の別地図を用意して作成時の異なる基準を公開説明する。

sentences.en: Some alternatives prioritize similar population sizes, whereas others give greater weight to existing community connections or geographical barriers.
sentences.ja: 人口規模の類似を優先する案もあれば既存の地域のつながりや地理的障壁をより重視する案もある。

sentences.en: The council acknowledges that preserving every existing connection could create substantial differences in the number of residents represented at each meeting.
sentences.ja: 既存のつながりを全て維持すれば各会議が代表する住民数に大幅な差が生じ得ると認める。

sentences.en: Rather than presenting one arrangement as objectively perfect, it describes the trade-offs associated with each proposal.
sentences.ja: 一案を客観的に完璧と示すのでなく各案に伴う取引条件を説明する。

sentences.en: For this hypothetical exercise, officials invite comments about the practical consequences of particular boundaries without treating every received opinion as representative of all residents.
sentences.ja: この仮想活動では寄せられた全意見を全住民の代表と見なさず個々の境界の実際的影響について意見を求める。

sentences.en: They also examine whether meetings could remain accessible through alternative venues or additional opportunities for participation.
sentences.ja: 別会場や追加参加機会で会議へのアクセスを維持できるかも調べる。

sentences.en: The council distinguishes decisions about the boundaries themselves from decisions about the services provided inside them.
sentences.ja: 境界自体の決定と内部で提供するサービスの決定を区別する。

sentences.en: It does not claim that the exercise establishes a legally appropriate districting method for any actual election or municipality.
sentences.ja: この活動が実際の選挙や自治体に法的に適切な区割り方法を確立すると主張しない。

sentences.en: The example illustrates that a seemingly technical classification can embody judgments about which features of a community deserve priority.
sentences.ja: 一見技術的な分類にも地域のどの特徴を優先すべきかの判断が含まれ得ると例は示す。

sentences.en: A numerical procedure may reduce some kinds of arbitrary decision-making without removing the need to justify the criteria that guide it.
sentences.ja: 数値手順は一部の恣意的判断を減らしてもそれを導く基準の正当化の必要はなくさない。

sentences.en: Transparency therefore requires more than disclosing the calculation used to produce an outcome.
sentences.ja: 透明性には結果を出す計算の公開以上のことが必要だ。

sentences.en: It also requires explaining why the selected objectives are relevant to the public purpose that the classification is supposed to serve.
sentences.ja: 選択した目標が分類の果たすべき公共目的になぜ関連するか説明する必要もある。

questions.prompt: What is the district map intended for?
Why are the boundaries described as neutral?
options: They were produced using a numerical rule.

questions.prompt: What problem does the railway create?
options: It separates areas with limited convenient crossings.
It makes every community facility identical.
The possibility of holding any meeting.
The assumption that numerical equality ensures practical access.
questions.explanation_ja: 数値平等と実用性の違い。

options: They give different weight to population and community connections.
They all use exactly the same criteria.
All criteria lead to identical results.
One objective has no practical consequences.

questions.prompt: What other options do officials examine?
options: Alternative venues and additional participation opportunities.

questions.prompt: Why distinguish boundary and service decisions?
options: Access can be influenced by arrangements beyond the map itself.
The districts have no intended purpose.
questions.explanation_ja: 地図以外の条件も重要。

options: Give concrete form to an idea.
Technical rules require transparent justification of their objectives and trade-offs.
Numerical procedures eliminate all value judgments.
Community boundaries should never use population data.
One map is always objectively perfect.
questions.explanation_ja: 基準の根拠と得失を説明する。

paraphrases.source: The planners describe the boundaries as neutral because they were calculated according to a numerical rule rather than drawn by individual officials.
paraphrases.rewrite: Planners regard the boundaries as impartial because a numerical procedure produced them.

paraphrases.source: The resident argues that the map's arithmetic may be accurate while its assumptions about people's ability to meet remain open to question.
paraphrases.rewrite: Correct arithmetic does not automatically establish that residents can attend meetings easily.

paraphrases.source: Some alternatives prioritize similar population sizes, whereas others give greater weight to existing community connections or geographical barriers.
paraphrases.rewrite: Different proposals emphasize either similar populations or existing connections and obstacles.

paraphrases.source: A numerical procedure may reduce some kinds of arbitrary decision-making without removing the need to justify the criteria that guide it.
paraphrases.rewrite: Using a numerical rule can limit arbitrary choices, but the criteria still need reasons.
